blocks.text: This October, the King of the Monsters returns to the big screen at the first “Godzilla Film Festival” in the Philippines. This event will bring iconic films to Philippine cinemas, offering fans the chance to experience these monster movies as they were meant to be seen—larger than life and within all the spectacle of the cinema. Fans can catch the festival and watch for as low as PHP 275 per ticket, from October 14 to 20 exclusively at select SM Cinemas.
